# One real paper, recorded

Gibbons CH, et al. "Structural and functional small fiber abnormalities in the neuropathic postural
tachycardia syndrome." PLoS ONE 2013. PMID 24386408, PMC3874039, CC BY licence.

Responses recorded on 2026-11-06 and replayed by `tests/test_one_paper.py`:

| File | Request |
|---|---|
| `pubmed.xml` | E-utilities efetch, the PubMed record |
| `pubtator.json` | PubTator3 export (abstract annotations) |
| `icite.json` | iCite references and citing papers |
| `related.json` | E-utilities elink, PubMed similar articles with scores |
| `mesh_esearch.json`, `mesh_esummary.json` | the MeSH descriptor D054972 |
